title: Custom switch responds only to pointer input
description: The alert preference is a focusable div with role=switch. It has a click handler but no key handling, so Enter and Space do nothing even though the control is in the tab order.

relatedElements.note: A native button with role=switch, which handles Space and Enter.

expectedBehaviour: A switch in the tab order can be operated with the keyboard, using the keys its role implies.
actualBehaviour: Only a pointer click toggles aria-checked; keyboard activation is ignored.
userImpact: Keyboard, switch and voice-control users can reach the setting but cannot change it.

detection.note: The role, name and focusability are all correct, so static checks pass.

manualTests: Focus the switch and press Space, then Enter. Confirm that the state does not change.

assistiveTechnologyTests.procedure: Focus the switch and press Space. Listen for the state change.

assertions: Space and Enter leave aria-checked as false; a click sets it to true.
tests: tests/subtle-defects.spec.js: keeps the pointer-only switch inoperable from the keyboard

reviewStatus.note: A Playwright regression test preserves the defective behaviour and its control. That is automated reproduction, not a manual or assistive-technology observation.
